mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and increasing the present value of S&P 500 earnings, leading to positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer confidence and corporate hiring expectations, which leads to lower near-term earnings growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, signaling weakening economic momentum and reduced corporate profitability, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in residential construction (HOUST) above 460.0 thousand units, combined with a rising trend in real personal consumption (RSAFS), signals a recovery in consumer-driven demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 460.0 and RSAFS shows upward trend over 2 months
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 212.5 with a 12-month increase exceeding 3.0% signals inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts or initiate tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 9.0% and a rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 132,000 thousand signals a tightening labor market, increasing wage pressures and corporate input costs, which reduces profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters, combined with a falling industrial production (INDPRO), indicates a deepening economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings and investor confidence, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 shows negative growth in two consecutive quarters and INDPRO < 97.0
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
